## Caveats (not fixed — don't affect this question)

- **flipper_length_mm** has 3 negative values (e.g. "-184", "-211") that violate the rule range [170, 235], but this column isn't used in the question, so I left it.
- body_mass_g was clean (numeric, within the 2500–6500 g rule range), so no changes were needed there.

The totals above are based on 61 rows (after removing the 1 duplicate).
